stories.story_fr: L'adoption de l'IA generative s'accelere a un rythme exceptionnel : le nombre de clients depensant plus d'1 M USD d'ACV sur Now Assist a bondi de plus de 130% sur un an, signe que l'IA agentique passe a l'echelle dans les grands comptes.
stories.story_en: GenAI adoption is accelerating at an exceptional pace: the number of customers spending over $1 million in annual contract value on Now Assist grew over 130% year-over-year, a sign that agentic AI is scaling across large accounts.
stories.quote: Now Assist customers spending over $1 million in annual contract value grew over 130% year-over-year

stories.story_fr: ServiceNow se repositionne en 'tour de controle IA pour la reinvention des entreprises', revendiquant une integration agnostique avec tout modele, cloud, interface, donnee et systeme, ce qui en fait l'orchestrateur de l'entreprise agentique.
stories.story_en: ServiceNow is repositioning as the 'AI control tower for business reinvention', claiming model-, cloud- and system-agnostic integration that makes it the orchestrator of the agentic enterprise.
stories.quote: Today, they rely on ServiceNow to be their AI control tower for business reinvention. Customers trust our platform because we integrate with any model, cloud, interface, data, and system they choose to deploy.

stories.story_fr: Deux acquisitions de cybersecurite bouclees au T1 2026 (Armis le 20 avril, Veza le 2 mars) etoffent un stack de securite de bout en bout qui voit, decide et agit sur tout le perimetre technologique, et elargissent le marche adressable.
stories.story_en: Two cybersecurity acquisitions closed in Q1 2026 (Armis on April 20, Veza on March 2) build an end-to-end security stack that can see, decide and act across the entire technology footprint, while expanding the addressable market.
stories.quote: The early close of our Armis acquisition meaningfully expands our TAM and accelerates our subscription revenue growth trajectory.

stories.story_fr: Lancement d'Autonomous Workforce, une nouvelle classe de specialistes IA executant des taches d'entreprise de bout en bout avec gouvernance integree, le premier etant un agent de support IT de niveau 1 qui diagnostique et resout en autonomie.
stories.story_en: Launch of Autonomous Workforce, a new class of AI specialists that execute enterprise jobs end-to-end with built-in governance, the first being a Level 1 Service Desk AI Specialist that autonomously diagnoses and resolves IT requests.
stories.quote: ServiceNow also launched Autonomous Workforce, a new class of AI specialists that execute enterprise jobs end-to-end with built-in governance and human oversight.

stories.story_fr: ServiceNow affiche un profil 'Rule of 55+' (somme croissance + marge), se positionnant comme l'entreprise logicielle la mieux placee pour une croissance rentable et durable a l'ere de l'IA agentique.
stories.story_en: ServiceNow sustains a 'Rule of 55+' profile (growth plus margin), positioning itself as the best-placed software company for sustainable, profitable growth in an agentic AI world.
stories.quote: With our consistent Rule of 55+ profile, there is no AI company in the enterprise better positioned for sustainable profitable revenue growth than ServiceNow.

stories.story_fr: Partenariat elargi avec Anthropic pour integrer plus profondement les modeles Claude dans la plateforme IA de ServiceNow, afin de permettre aux developpeurs de tous niveaux de creer des workflows agentiques avec gouvernance native.
stories.story_en: Expanded partnership with Anthropic to integrate Claude models more deeply into the ServiceNow AI Platform, enabling developers of all skill levels to build and deploy agentic workflows with built-in governance.
stories.quote: ServiceNow and Anthropic announced an expanded partnership to integrate Claude models more deeply into the ServiceNow AI Platform.
